The datasets python_frontend ASTBlobRecord name is a compatibility alias of ASTRecord and is not the accelerator ASTBlobRecord schema.
The datasets TypeScript frontend and crypto-exchange PythonASTExtractor are not the Python v1 AST tool.
MCP++ PatchProposal is a wire schema only and cannot apply, admit, or prove a patch.
CodeEditPacket, CodeEditMaterialize, MutationLedger, and handoff PatchEvent are not a CanonicalCodeIR-to-exact-source linker.

inventory.finding: CanonicalASTRecord/ASTRecord is the datasets-owned, language-neutral, closed DAG-JSON AST/symbol IR. Records bind source CID, path, repository, revision, optional tree CID, byte/line/column SourceSpan, symbols, scopes, signatures, imports, unresolved references/calls, effects, diagnostics, and unsupported constructs. Content identity is software-contract-cid-profile-v1 CIDv1. References and calls carry no resolved target. This is the nearest existing code-IR authority. The identifier CanonicalCodeIR@1 is absent from all four nested repositories.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse as the datasets code-IR authority. PCSM-010 must select this schema or add the smallest versioned wrapper; do not fork a second AST IR.

inventory.finding: The frontend uses only ast.parse, never imports or executes analyzed source, and emits lexical facts into ASTRecord. Parse, encoding, and resource failures become diagnostics and UnsupportedConstruct records. python_frontend.ASTBlobRecord is an alias of ASTRecord, not the accelerator ASTBlobRecord. python_analysis projects frontend declarations into semantic-index symbols and classifies eval/exec/reflection/native/control-flow opacity; it does not emit a CFG or data-flow IR.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse as the Python v1 AST tool. Do not treat control-flow opacity tags as a PCSM CFG/data-flow compiler.

inventory.system: Datasets incremental semantic index and typed symbol graph
inventory.finding: The index scans a repository into a CID-bound RepositoryState with stable symbol IDs, version IDs, git commit/tree snapshot identity, typed edges, invalidation plans, and bounded explanations. Resolution statuses are definite, finite_may, or unresolved; ambiguous targets are not guessed. This is the datasets symbol-index authority. It is not a current-tree M1 linker.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse for Python symbol identity, snapshot binding, and invalidation. Do not replace it with the accelerator vector index.

inventory.finding: The resolver joins frontend lexical facts against an explicit RepositoryComposition without importing analyzed code. Answers are definite, finite_may, unresolved, optional, missing, or revision-mismatch. Mirror modules and stale revisions fail closed.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse for conservative resolution. It is not alias-to-canonical M1 relinking.

inventory.finding: Projects ASTRecord into a closed asts catalog (source_revisions, files, blobs, nodes, scopes, symbols, imports, references, calls, effects, interfaces, diagnostics, invalidations) while preserving source CID, AST IR CID, and spans. Incompatible AST schema and identity drift fail closed. This is not a second AST schema and is not the accelerator DuckDBASTIndex.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse as a query projection of datasets AST IR. Do not treat it as CanonicalCodeIR.

inventory.finding: Publishes and consumes ASTRecord through the shared syntax kernel. Identity mismatch, malformed payload, unsupported constructs, and free-form input fail closed. ASTRecord remains the typed owner.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse as a kernel adapter. Do not treat syntax-core source maps as PCSM M1 Python source-link receipts.

inventory.finding: Reads verified source bytes for a stable symbol only through a sealed snapshot/tree-bound index view. Wrong producer state, missing blob, CID mismatch, TOCTOU reread mismatch, and path fallback all fail closed. This admits exact current bytes and spans; it does not rewrite source.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse as the exact-byte admission surface for later M1 linking. It is not SourceLinkReceipt@1.

inventory.finding: Emits lexical facts into the same ASTRecord contract through a pinned Node TypeScript compiler-API worker. Compiler absence, version mismatch, and protocol failure become unsupported AST evidence. Other languages are out of PCSM Python v1 scope.
inventory.reuse_decision: Do not select as the Python v1 AST tool. Keep as an adjacent same-IR frontend for later language work only.

inventory.system: Accelerator path-independent AST blob record and query index
inventory.finding: Accelerator ASTBlobRecord parses Python with ast.parse and records path-independent source/blob hashes, symbols, imports, calls, bounded line spans, and parse failures. AnalysisASTIndex attaches safe repository-relative paths and exposes bounded lookup. It is derived supervisor evidence, not datasets ASTRecord.
inventory.reuse_decision: Consume only as derived analysis input after snapshot freshness is verified. Do not promote it to CanonicalCodeIR.

inventory.finding: Projects accelerator ASTBlobRecord facts into a versioned source snapshot and parse cache using python-ast@schema-1. Declared authority class is derived_evidence. Parser drift, unsupported languages, and failed parses are explicit frontiers. Distinct from datasets DuckDBASTStore@1.
Serializes versioned vector rows bound to an exact snapshot, rejects bodies and forged/stale configuration, and marks every hit semantic_authority=False. Similarity is recall only.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse only as advisory recall. Never as symbol identity.

inventory.finding: ArchitectureIR is a closed version-1 architecture graph with dag-json CIDv1 identities. Program-graph is a content-addressed projection of repository/module/symbol/call/contract evidence with explicit unresolved frontiers. Neither is the datasets Python CanonicalCodeIR, CFG, or data-flow compiler.
inventory.reuse_decision: Consume for accelerator planning/evidence graphs only.

inventory.system: Accelerator program-AST adapters and dependency graph
inventory.finding: Adapters project Python/JS/TS/JSON/Markdown onto accelerator ASTBlobRecord plus observational sidecars. Ambiguous imports, monkey patches, and dynamic calls stay explicit and never mint resolved call edges. The dependency graph is a snapshot-bound typed ProgramGraph with derived_evidence authority. This is not datasets ASTRecord and not a Python CanonicalCodeIR CFG/data-flow compiler.
inventory.reuse_decision: Consume as derived analysis only. Do not select as the Python v1 AST tool or CFG authority.

inventory.finding: Adapts Python, JSON-schema-like documents, and a local TypeScript compiler API onto accelerator ASTBlobRecord. Python v1 must use the datasets frontend. Other languages are out of PCSM v1 scope.
inventory.reuse_decision: Do not select as the Python v1 AST tool.

inventory.finding: Records admitted byte changes as content-addressed before/after evidence with AST edit lineage. Stale fences and incomplete lineage fail closed. Declared authority class is derived_evidence. This is a ledger of already-admitted mutations, not a typed IR patch parser or deterministic source linker.

inventory.system: Patch proposal, validation, materialization, and handoff events
inventory.authority: ipfs_accelerate_py admits and materializes; Mcp-Plus-Plus owns the patch-proposal wire schema only
inventory.finding: The MCP++ schema is closed, CIDv1-base32 bound, and forbids simulated-to-live promotion. Accelerator validation parses Git-style unified diffs without a shell and rejects scope, syntax, stale-binding, identity, secret, and test-weakening cases. CodeEditPacket is a content-addressed implementable-unit projection with semantic_authority=false prover bindings. These are the patch-system equivalents to reuse. No current-head component is a CanonicalCodeIR-to-exact-source relinker, SemanticIRPatchPlan@1, or SourceLinkReceipt@1.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse the wire schema plus accelerator admission/materialization controls. Do not treat unified-diff admission as M1 IR linking.

inventory.system: Adjacent non-selected IR and storage surfaces
inventory.authority: ipfs_datasets_py owns adjacent semantic IRs; ipfs_kit_py owns exact bytes only
inventory.finding: Software-contract IR models callable/effect/exception contracts, not Python AST. Source-lineage records corpus/release provenance, not M1 node/span maps. SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1 compiles capsules from the semantic index and is not CanonicalCodeIR. The crypto-exchange PythonASTExtractor emits SecurityModelIR seed facts and is not the software-contracts PythonASTExtractor. Kit has no code IR. No Python CFG or data-flow CanonicalCodeIR was found. libcst, tree-sitter, bowler, and redbaron are not the selected Python v1 frontend.
inventory.reuse_decision: Do not promote these to CanonicalCodeIR, CFG, or source-link authority.

Datasets semantic-index states, symbols, snapshots, and stable IDs are schema-versioned and CID-bound.

The vector index binds rows to an exact snapshot and is expressly non-semantic authority.
